verdict.rationale: Fathom supports background automation via webhooks that fire on meeting completion (auto-sending transcripts/summaries/action items to external URLs), automatic CRM field syncing after meetings, and automatic key-topic monitoring, all of which run without user intervention. However, these are fixed, event-triggered integrations rather than a configurable agentic automation/workflow builder — there's no evidence of scheduling, multi-step autonomous task chains, or user-defined agent logic running continuously in the background. Missing for 10: a true automation/workflow builder, evidence of multi-step or scheduled autonomous agent execution, and independent confirmation these automations work reliably unattended.
